props.gloss_en: the first tanna: a kid that bore three daughters, and each of her daughters bore three -- all of them enter the pen to be tithed
R' Shimon: I saw [such a kid] that yielded tithe within its year
answer 1: Ze'eiri's rule is what is between them
Ze'eiri: there is no טינוף less than thirty days
answer 1: R' Shimon does not hold Ze'eiri's rule (gloss-only: the text gives no rival content for the rule)
answer 2: they dispute whether an animal gives birth after incomplete months
an animal does not give birth after incomplete months
an animal gives birth after incomplete months
answer 3: they dispute whether part of the day is as the whole of it
we do not say part of the day is as the whole of it
we say part of the day is as the whole of it
answer 4: they dispute whether an animal lacking time enters the pen to be tithed
an animal lacking time enters the pen to be tithed
an animal lacking time does not enter the pen to be tithed (the other side of the dispute 21a.5 states)

the baraita: R' Shimon ben Yehuda in R' Shimon's name -- an animal lacking time enters the pen, and is like the firstborn: as the firstborn is holy before its time and offered after its time, so is one lacking time
an animal lacking time [entered for tithe] is holy before its time and offered after its time
Rava, as the shepherds say: a murky [discharge] that held back a fetus
Shmuel: bubbles of blood
and one must show it to a chakham
Rav Pappa: [the chakham meant is] a knowledgeable shepherd
Rav Chisda: they said, the formation of a fetus in a woman is forty days
Rav Pappa (asking): is Ze'eiri's rule not the answer -- a measure of fetal formation in an animal?
that was said of receiving [a male]
Rav: one who buys [an animal not known to have given birth] from a Jew -- [its offspring] is a definite firstborn (the mishna's case is one who buys from a gentile, מצינו לוקח מגוי)
Rav's reason: had it given birth, [the seller] would have boasted of it to him
Shmuel: an uncertain firstborn
Shmuel's reason: [the seller] thought he wanted it for slaughter [and did not trouble to say]
R' Yochanan: definitely non-sacred
R' Yochanan's reason (the stam's answer to מאי טעמא): had it not given birth, since a prohibition is at stake, [the seller] would have informed him
the baraita: if [the seller] did not inform him, he goes and slaughters and need not refrain

schemas.gloss_en: מה בכור קדוש לפני זמנו וקרב לאחר זמנו, אף מחוסר זמן -- as the firstborn, so the tithe animal lacking time (R' Shimon, as R' Shimon ben Yehuda reports him)

grounds.gloss_en: ואדיליף מבכור, נילף מקדשים? -- why learn the tithe from the firstborn and not from [other] sacrifices?

answered_by.gloss_en: מסתברא מבכור הוה ליה למילף, שכן: גואל, מום, תמורת, אכילה -- the firstborn and the tithe share redemption, blemish, substitute and eating

grounds.gloss_en: אדרבה, מקדשים הוה ליה למילף, שכן: זכר, קדוש, במתנות, פשוט -- on the contrary, learn from sacrifices: the tithe shares with them male [and female], holy [by act], among the gifts, ordinary. Counters the מסתברא answer and renews the pircha; unanswered -- אלא

schemas.gloss_en: אלא רבי שמעון ״העברה״ ״העברה״ גמיר -- 'והעברת' of the firstborn (Shemot 13:12) and 'כל אשר יעבר תחת השבט' of the tithe (Vayikra 27:32); ascribed to him by the stam

questions.gloss_en: Rav Chisda asks: in an animal, how many [days to the formation of the fetus]? -- Rav Pappa's proposal from Ze'eiri is rejected (ההוא לקבל איתמר); the text records no resolution and no תיקו

supports.gloss_en: והתניא: רבי שמעון בן יהודה אומר משום רבי שמעון: מחוסר זמן נכנס לדיר להתעשר (marker והתניא; kind tanya_nami_hachi is the nearest member)
תניא כוותיה דרבי יוחנן דאמר חולין: אם לא הודיעו -- הולך ושוחט ואינו נמנע

objections.gloss_en: חכם מנא ידע? -- how would a Sage know [a discharge]?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רב פפא: רועה חכם -- a knowledgeable shepherd (= p_roeh_chacham)

objections.gloss_en: לימא תיהוי תיובתא דרב ושמואל? -- the baraita presumes the seller informs; so an uninformed buyer may rely on silence, as R' Yochanan

answered_by.gloss_en: התם במוכר תליא מילתא, הכא בלוקח תליא מילתא -- there the matter depends on the seller, here on the buyer

objections.gloss_en: לימא תיהוי תיובתא דרב ושמואל? (the same proposed refutation, against Shmuel)

answered_by.gloss_en: התם במוכר תליא מילתא, הכא בלוקח תליא מילתא
